title: Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Tier and the Ridgeline Tool Rental Damage Protection Limit
content:
Premier and Preferred Ridgeline Consumer Credit cardholders carry a higher protection limit on disputed Ridgeline Tool Rental damage repair charges.

**Benefit.** The Ridgeline Consumer Credit tier raises the protection limit of the agreement: a renter whose Ridgeline Consumer Credit account is active at the Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Premier tier adds 2500.00 dollars; one whose account is active at the Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Preferred tier adds 1000.00 dollars; any other renter adds nothing.

The amount is added to the protection limit of the agreement, against which the protected repair cost is measured; no amount on the way to the adjustment is rounded, the adjustment being rounded to the cent only at the end.

The tier and status read are those on the renter's Ridgeline Consumer Credit account record.

| Ridgeline Consumer Credit account | Added to the protection limit |
|---|---|
| Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Premier, active | 2500.00 |
| Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Preferred, active | 1000.00 |
| Classic, a Project Loan, Premier or Preferred not active, or no account | nothing |

## Hypothetical illustration

On a Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting agreement with a class coverage limit of 5000.00, an active Premier cardholder's protection limit includes the 2500.00 added here, so a protected repair cost of 7000.00 lies within it.
